episodes.instruction: Put the orange ball between the soup can and the tomato sauce can.

review.summary: The person picks up the orange ball and places it between the two cans, matching the robot's end state, with a clean single-hand interaction.
review.verify: f_001 matches robot 0.0s frame with robot removed: ball lower-left, blue box left, two cans, yellow card, brown box all in the same places. f_002-f_006: an empty right hand comes in from the bottom edge and grasps the ball where it started. f_007-f_018: the hand carries the ball right and up to the gap between the two cans. Only one hand appears, and it is the only thing touching the ball. f_013/f_015 closeups: the hand passes near the brown box and yellow card, but neither moves. Both are in the same spots in f_031 as in f_001. f_025-f_028: the hand releases the ball and leaves empty out the bottom edge. In f_031 the ball sits between the soup can and the tomato sauce can, a little right of the line between them, which matches the robot 18.2s frame. No duplicates, overlays or cuts.
review.robot: Ball grasped f146-189 with a two-finger grasp (wrist f150-240), carried, and released f357-369 between the soup can and the tomato sauce can. From f409 to f549 the ball stays in the same place between the cans and does not roll. The cans and distractors do not move.
